name: Historic Centre of Riga
description: Riga's historic centre sits on the east bank of the Daugava River in Latvia. Its medieval lanes, shaped by wealth from Hanseatic trade, are dotted with old churches such as Riga Cathedral and St. Peter's. Beyond them lie 19th-century districts of grand wooden houses and Jugendstil façades, forming what is widely considered Europe's finest collection of art nouveau buildings.
